chunks: From him, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim, they said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said:
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) used to say: 'Whoever recites behind an Imam whom he follows in prayer, and then dies, will be resurrected not upon the primordial nature (fitrah).'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on reciting Quran behind the Imam during congregational prayer?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) narrates that Imam Ali (peace be upon him) stated that a person who recites their own Quranic verses behind the Imam during congregational prayer, rather than remaining silent, will be resurrected not upon the natural fitrah (primordial nature) of Islam. This highlights the jurisprudential ruling on recitation behind the Imam.
